title: Ruthless Jungle Fever Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Jungle Fever by Ruthless is a vibrant tropical medley that brings together the bright, tangy notes of Pineapple with the juicy sweetness of ripe Mango. A splash of citrus rounds out the blend, adding a zesty, mouth-puckering twist to the inhale while keeping the exhale smooth and balanced. This bold and refreshing e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy exotic fruit combinations with a tangy edge. Part of the renowned Ruthless Shortfill range, Jungle Fever features a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio for thick vapour production and a rich, full-bodied flavour. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced devices, it is supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, giving vapers the freedom to customise their nicotine strength. Ruthless has been a leading name in American e-liquids for over a decade, known for crafting complex, standout flavours that have inspired countless imitations. Their dedication to high-quality ingredients and bold, adventurous blends continues to set them apart in the world of vaping.
